items.title: William "Big Bill" Thompson Interview, 1961-03-01
items.q: Like I remember they had this Red Caillou, they had Lil Willa, they had Lil Kato and Big Kato, they had One Leg Alex Seed, and they had the old Blind Frank uptown. And myself, sometime we'd run across them uptown up there around the Garden District and we'd go on to bucking.

ctx.x: Did you ever get in any competition with other piano players?

Oh, yeah, that's all time to meet that. Oh, yeah? Oh, yeah, you know all the time. How did that work? You'd meet Lil Willa and you'd get in a place and what fella would be playing and then two, three might be there to play and everybody go to bucking one another. Did you take turns on the piano? Yeah, everybody take a turn, want to see who could play the best. Like I remember they had this Red Caillou, they had Lil Willa, they had Lil Kato and Big Kato, they had One Leg Alex Seed, and they had the old Blind Frank…
Oh, yeah, I'm afraid of him. What's his last name?
